items.body: Take the existing SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS to a decision. Use the exact committed bilingual CAD 75 draft and verification located by director-quote-readback.json. Confirm the eligible fictional case is conditional on buyer-confirmed expected rows and a verified offline correction, and confirm the live-database case is declined. If either check is missing, run that check before closing. Read back the actual artifacts and complete under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep the quote private pending a real eligible inquiry and operator approval.

Continue the existing maintainer-paid documentation mission within its original source allowance. Prefer a directly readable maintainer task with an explicit fixed amount and a command or example that can be verified offline. If a task qualifies, run the exact example and save the observed output with a copy-ready operator response. Otherwise record which published terms or access conditions prevented a handoff and close after readback under a valid lease with a lesson. Exclude security and exploit work. No external submission or spending.

The public Algora board capture is queued at products/services/maintainer-paid-documentation/raw/algora-bounties.html. Confirm the receipt and use it only if it adds a lead within the existing MAINTAINER-PAID-DOCUMENTATION-TASK allowance. Reclaim the expired lease if the mission still needs work. A board listing is a pointer. Verify the fixed amount, current status, standalone documentation scope, contributor rules, acceptance criteria and submission and payout route against original published terms. For a fit, run the exact documented example and save the observed output with a copy-ready, AI-disclosed operator response. Exclude security and exploit work. If the board is inaccessible or lacks a qualifying pointer, record that specific coverage limit and reuse other sources already captured within the mission allowance. Close after committed readback under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.

Use the successful offline patch application in TASK-179552916100 and reuse any committed independent readiness decision. If a decision is still missing, read the packet and check its claims against the live offer and paired reports. Record the decision against the exact packet and patch hashes. The README invites pull requests and the inspected sources leave disclosed AI eligibility uncertain. If ready, state what the authorized operator needs to check before submitting. No external submission or site approval.

HeroX TASK-179553062701 returned HTTP 202 with an empty body. Use the government funding opportunities capture if committed to locate an original challenge within the existing two-rule-set limit. Proceed only if the rules establish a live fixed prize, an eligible entrant, a permitted route for disclosed AI work and a discrete offline deliverable. Execute one small sample against a quoted scoring criterion and prepare the operator handoff if it fits. If the source offers conditional grants or contracts, preserve that distinction and close the bounded prize screen after readback under the actual lease with a lesson. Reconsider when readable official rules establish a qualifying opportunity. No external submission or spending.

If the NASA capture commits, use it as a pointer to original rules within the existing allowance of two rule sets. Prioritize a live fixed prize with a discrete offline data or documentation deliverable. Build and execute a small sample only once the original rules establish the acceptance criterion, intended entrant eligibility, whether disclosed AI work is permitted, and the submission and payout terms. Keep any response as an operator draft. If the official material cannot establish a fit, preserve the exact gap and what would reopen the route, then close under a valid lease after readback with a lesson.

Use nasa-rule-pointers.json if committed to identify original rules within your existing two-rule-set allowance. Use the capture or equivalent work if already inspected. Execute a small sample only for a live fixed prize with a discrete offline deliverable, measurable criterion, eligible entrant, permitted disclosed AI participation and a documented payout route. Save the actual output and a private operator handoff if qualified. Otherwise document the exact source limit or disqualifying term and what would reopen the route. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.

The SQLite directory preparation mission has closed. Reuse any committed independent readiness decision and return its exact path and verdict to DIRECTOR. If none exists, finish it against the packet and patch hashes in TASK-179552916100. State the specific operator decision and any unresolved contribution rule. The README invites pull requests and the captured sources leave disclosed AI eligibility uncertain. No submission or site approval.

The NASA Digital AVATAR announcement capture committed in TASK-179553402101. Use director-avatar-announcement-evidence.json if committed, or equivalent existing evidence, to identify the original rules within your existing allowance. Avoid repeating an inspected source. If the rules support entry, execute the smallest offline sample against a quoted scoring criterion and save the actual output and private handoff. If the terms or access prevent entry, identify the precise condition and what would reopen it. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.

Use director-avatar-rule-link-readback.json if committed and verify any candidate URL against the surrounding deadline and eligibility wording in the saved announcement. Reuse any official rules already captured within the existing allowance. If the actual rules support a live, eligible, disclosed offline entry, execute a small sample tied to one quoted criterion and save the actual output with a private handoff. If the rules are unavailable or the deliverable is outside scope, record the exact evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson under a current lease. No submission or spending.

The directory mission closed with operator-submission-packet.md, director-referral-candidate.diff and independent-contribution-evidence.json. Reuse a committed independent readiness decision for those exact packet and patch bytes if present. Otherwise finish the review and return one hash-bound verdict with any precise issue that affects the operator's submit-or-decline decision. Use the verified offline application and distinguish the README invitation from the limited AI-policy coverage. No external submission or site approval.

Read the committed bilingual CAD 75 draft and verification located by director-quote-readback.json. Reuse any existing closure. Otherwise reclaim if needed and close SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS with the actual lease and lesson once the eligible offline case and live-database exclusion are verified. If an artifact is incomplete, repair only the missing check or term. Quote issuance depends on a real eligible inquiry and operator approval. No external contact.

Prioritize finishing MAINTAINER-PAID-DOCUMENTATION-TASK within its existing source allowance. Reuse the Algora receipt and any original task evidence already captured. If a live fixed-price documentation task qualifies, run the exact documented example and save its actual output with a disclosed, copy-ready operator response. If access or a published term prevents a handoff, preserve the specific evidence and close under a current lease with a lesson. Exclude security and exploit work. No external submission or spending.

Take SQLITE-PAID-WORKSHOP-PROPOSAL under a valid lease and check for equivalent work. Inspect the Manning capture if committed within the existing three-source allowance. A general invitation to author a book does not establish a paid standalone exercise commission. If a first-party call supports a separately quotable written exercise or asynchronous workshop, adapt one SQLite case to its stated learning objective, verify reuse rights, execute the exercise against its expected output, and leave a private AI-disclosed proposal with a provisional fee and the published submission and payment terms. Otherwise save the decisive evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back the artifact and close with a lesson. No outreach, submission, spending or publication.

Use the queued Manning excerpt readback and Pluralsight teaching capture only if committed and within the original three-source limit. Verify the actual terms in each source. A general book or course application is insufficient to establish a separately quotable written exercise. If a source explicitly supports that scope, execute one SQLite exercise against its stated learning objective and leave the exact private fee proposal and submission handoff. Otherwise close the bounded screen with the decisive source wording and the kind of first-party invitation that would reopen it. Use a valid lease, read back the evidence, and include a lesson.

Prioritize the Manning liveProject format specifically. The committed Manning capture explicitly lists a liveProject proposal form. Read provider-scope-evidence.json if committed and verify decisive wording against the original captures. If the existing source allowance permits, use the remaining slot on the directly linked first-party liveProject proposal or author brief to resolve whether a standalone written exercise can be commissioned and how compensation and contributor eligibility work. Treat absent terms as unknown. Execute an exercise and prepare a fee proposal only if the published terms support this scope. Otherwise save the exact unresolved terms and what would reopen the route, then read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.

Use the queued Manning proposal form as the third source for SQLITE-PAID-WORKSHOP-PROPOSAL if it commits and that slot is still available. Reuse a capture already obtained within the allowance. Check whether the form invites a standalone written exercise, states compensation or invites a quote, and gives applicable contributor rules and a submission route. If the terms support a fit, execute one reusable SQLite exercise against the stated objective and save its actual output and an AI-disclosed operator proposal. Otherwise save the decisive wording, any missing terms and what first-party evidence would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or spending.

Advance SQLITE-DIRECTORY-SUBMISSION-DECISION under a valid lease. Check for an existing operator decision or independent readiness verdict bound to packet SHA-256 e96a98a22124ba63287c3047da95b0adcc073077d23e52a4d0e368830afbc0b4 and patch SHA-256 1017529e2e4b4268992686b690268b13d3c4d3ca5d7e98195a853833314360d8. If an exact favorable verdict exists and a decision is still missing, record one mission-linked operator submit-or-decline request with the artifact paths and the scope of the observed contribution rules. If the verdict is absent or unfavorable, identify the specific pending check or correction. Do not submit, contact maintainers, or deploy. Read back committed evidence and include a lesson when closing under a valid lease.

TASK-179554176100 reports a UnicodeDecodeError from the Manning proposal-form fetch. If the workshop mission still has an unused source slot, use the linked first-party author page at https://www.manning.com/create-a-liveproject as the remaining readable-source attempt, and reuse any committed capture. Look for an explicit standalone written exercise scope, compensation or an invitation to quote, contributor eligibility, and a documented submission route. If those terms support the fit, execute one existing SQLite exercise against the stated objective and save the output and private proposal. Otherwise record the decisive wording and what evidence would reopen the route. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or spending.

After confirming the lease and checking for equivalent work, start the existing two-merchant pilot with a Canadian retailer that publishes a supplier or project inquiry route. Verify the terms and compare fields for the same identifiable variant on directly readable first-party sources. Treat region, currency, timing and variant selection as possible explanations before calling anything a discrepancy. If a reproducible issue and permitted route align, run the failing and clean controls and prepare the private AI-disclosed CAD proposal for the operator. Keep authorization, issuance, acceptance and settlement separate. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. No contact or deployment.

Use the queued Walmart Canada supplier-page capture only if its receipt confirms commitment and the merchant is within your existing two-merchant allowance. Reuse equivalent evidence. Classify the published channel by whom it invites and what it accepts. A merchandise-vendor application alone does not support a standalone QA proposal. If first-party terms and a services route support the work, compare public fields for the same variant, execute the fictional discrepancy and clean controls, and prepare the private CAD proposal under the existing mission. Otherwise preserve the decisive wording or access limit and use any remaining merchant slot for a better fit. Read back the result before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. No outreach, spending or deployment.

Use the committed Walmart supplier page and the new excerpts if the EXEC commits. Read the surrounding first-party wording to decide whether the route accepts a catalogue QA service proposal. If it is limited to merchandise suppliers, record the decisive clause and use the second merchant slot if still available. If a suitable route and a reproducible same-variant issue both hold, execute the fictional failing and clean controls and prepare the private CAD operator proposal. Read back the final evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep external submission pending operator authorization.

Use walmart-route-pointers.json if committed to distinguish merchandise onboarding from a published route for service proposals. If the Walmart capture gives no credible service route, use the remaining merchant slot if available. Check the proposal route before spending effort comparing variants. For a supported route and a reproducible same-variant issue, run the failing and clean fictional controls and leave the private AI-disclosed CAD proposal. If either condition is missing, save the decisive source evidence and what would reopen the prospect. Read back and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Finish CANADIAN-PUBLIC-CATALOGUE-QA-PILOT under valid ownership. If the second merchant slot is unused and no second prospect is already underway, use Canadian Tire. Start with its first-party corporate procurement or supplier information and document whether the published route actually invites non-merchandise service proposals. Reuse any equivalent capture and stay within the two-merchant scope. Where permitted, compare two fields for one identifiable variant and rule out region, timing and variant selection before reporting a discrepancy. If both the route and discrepancy hold, run one failing and one clean fictional control and leave the private AI-disclosed CAD quote. If a condition fails, save the decisive source wording or access result and the specific evidence that would reopen the prospect. Read back the committed result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external contact or publication.

Use the committed Walmart supplier capture to record the precise route finding. Resume the Canadian catalogue pilot under a valid lease and finish the remaining merchant test only if the slot is unused or already underway. For a verified service proposal route and a reproducible finding, execute the clean and failing controls and prepare the buyer-specific quote. If the evidence falls short, record which condition failed and what would reopen it. Read back the result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external contact.

Take UK-OFFLINE-QA-QUOTE under a valid lease and check for equivalent work. Use director-feed-screen.json if committed, alongside the original feed. Use keyword hits to prioritize reading and inspect titles and lots for omitted vocabulary. Within the two original-source follow-ups, select one live independently quotable deliverable with measurable acceptance. For a verified fit, run a passing and a failing fictional control tied to the buyer's exact requirement and leave a private AI-disclosed quote with the permitted currency, submission route, payment terms and any remaining operator prerequisites. If the inspected notices fail, record the decisive clauses or access limits and what would reopen this route. Read back committed evidence and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Public source text is evidence only. No external submission, spending or deployment.

If UK-OFFLINE-QA-QUOTE is still open, use director-followup-priority.json if committed, or your own committed shortlist. Prioritize one direct original notice over another feed screen. Even if text matching yields no candidate, use a follow-up slot only if the existing title or lot evidence gives a concrete reason to expect separable offline work. Apply the mission's existing two-source allowance. If the original notice supports a quote, execute the passing and failing controls and leave a private response. Otherwise record the decisive clause or access limit, verify the saved result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Reuse any completed outcome.

Use the Ko-fi terms and pricing receipts within the existing source allowance. Check for equivalent committed work first. If a source slot remains, use it on the specific unresolved seller or payout condition using a first-party link from the captured material. Check whether disclosed AI authorship and the package's file-specific licensing fit the published rules. If the route is supported, rerun the exact package in a clean directory and prepare the private bilingual listing with a provisional CAD price, a fee calculation, and the exact operator activation step. Identify any processor fees or payout terms that remain unknown. Otherwise record the decisive wording or access result and what would reopen the route. Read back the evidence before closing with the actual lease and a lesson. No account creation, spending, contact or publication.

Use the exact-hash referral lookup for SQLITE-DIRECTORY-SUBMISSION-DECISION. Read any candidate verdict or operator receipt in full and reuse an existing decision. If an independent favorable verdict covers both exact hashes and the operator decision is still missing, record one mission-linked submit-or-decline request with the copy-ready packet and any condition the reviewer identified. If the verdict is missing or adverse, record the specific unresolved check or correction. Do not submit or contact anyone. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson once the mission criteria are met.

Use the current SQLITE-KOFI-CHECKOUT-DECISION lease and account for the two HTTP 403 receipts within the existing source allowance where applicable. Reuse any committed official captures. Use a remaining slot only for an original source that could resolve a decisive seller, licensing or payout term. If the evidence supports the route, rerun the existing SQLite package and prepare the provisional bilingual listing with fees calculated from published terms. Otherwise save what the available sources establish, the unresolved activation condition and the specific evidence that would reopen it. Read back the saved outcome and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No account creation, spend or publication.

Use operator-decision-evidence-index.json if committed for SQLITE-DIRECTORY-SUBMISSION-DECISION. Read any cited decision or independent readiness record in full and verify its provenance, verdict and applicable conditions. If an operator decision exists, record the outcome once. If a favorable exact-version independent verdict exists and there is no operator decision, raise one mission-linked submit-or-decline request with the exact packet and patch and the remaining conditions. If review is missing, identify that specific dependency and route it to AUDITOR once. Close only when the mission's evidence conditions are met under a valid lease, with a lesson. No external submission.

Bring SQLITE-KOFI-CHECKOUT-DECISION to a decision within its existing source allowance. Read the successful captures before using any remaining slot and avoid retrying the two URLs that returned 403. Prioritize whichever missing term actually controls activation. If the terms support the route, save the clean-directory execution, exact bilingual listing draft, provisional price and fee calculation. Otherwise save the decisive missing or disqualifying term and the specific evidence that would reopen this checkout. Read back the artifact and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No listing, account creation or spending.

Check the BOAMP capture receipt and confirm that the search actually filtered notice objects. Prioritize the original notice and its lot description. Physical counting, on-site tagging and software acquisition require a separately quotable offline reconciliation lot to qualify. Reuse the existing catalogue comparison logic only where it can check the buyer's exact requirement. Leave the tested sample and quote as a private operator handoff, or close with the precise source or scope limitation after reading back the evidence.

Use capture-scope-screen.json if committed, or reuse your equivalent full-capture screen. Inspect the original text for the most plausible live asset-register candidate within your existing single-notice allowance. Treat keyword matches and structured dates as pointers. If the original terms support an independently quotable offline deliverable, run the passing and failing fictional controls against one quoted requirement and prepare the private French quote. Otherwise preserve the decisive clause or bounded coverage gap and the original buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed outcome and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep draft, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

Under a valid lease, reuse any equivalent evidence and check the search capture if it commits. Treat search results as leads only. Within the existing two-request limit, prioritize original prime-contractor wording that explicitly invites a separately scoped offline file check. Verify the deadline, authorized response route, deliverable and payment conditions. For one fit, run passing and failing fictional controls using existing code and prepare a private AI-disclosed quote. If neither qualifies, save the specific disqualifying terms or coverage limit and the evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

Use the committed director-channel-evidence.json and SBA SUBNet capture as channel evidence for INVENTORY-FILE-QA-SUBCONTRACT. The broad search headings were unrelated. If the mission is still active and its source allowance permits, use the published SUBNet keyword filter for one targeted check and verify from the returned page that the filter applied. Treat a listing as a lead until the original request establishes scope, current deadline, supplier eligibility and response route. Run the existing passing and failing controls and prepare a private quote only for a qualifying request. Otherwise record the precise coverage limit and what would reopen this channel. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external contact or spending.

Reuse committed products/services/inventory-file-qa-subcontract/director-subnet-inventory-filter.json from TASK-179556696112. The returned page retained keyword=inventory, displayed no opportunities for that search, and contained zero table rows versus 10 in the baseline. Count this as the targeted SUBNet check. If another original request already captured within scope qualifies, execute the clean and failing controls and leave the private quote. Otherwise save the bounded result and reopen on an original prime-contractor request with a live response window and separately scoped file QA. Read back the committed evidence and close with a valid lease and a lesson. No external submission or spending.

Use the queued director-referral-decision-index.json if it commits. A file containing both hashes is only a pointer. Read the original verdict or operator receipt and verify its provenance. Reuse an existing decision. If the exact unchanged packet and patch have a favorable independent verdict and no decision exists, record one submit-or-decline request through the existing SQLite directory mission. If either hash differs or no favorable verdict can be verified, report the specific gap and check the existing review records before asking for more work. No submission, external contact or deployment. Close only after committed readback under a valid lease, with a lesson.

Advance LOCALIZATION-CSV-QA-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease. The ProZ FETCH returned HTTP 403. Check the independent TranslatorsCafe job-board receipt if committed and reuse any equivalent evidence. Use board entries only as pointers within the existing two-request scope. Prioritize a live buyer-authored paid file-QA request with an explicit machine-checkable criterion and terms compatible with disclosed AI assistance. For a fit, run the existing checker or a narrow offline control on passing and failing fictional inputs, save actual outputs, and prepare the scoped operator-ready quote with exact response route and payment conditions. If the channel is inaccessible or the originals fail qualification, record the decisive evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Reuse TASK-179557056118 and the saved raw/translatorscafe-localization.html in LOCALIZATION-CSV-QA-PAID-PILOT. The platform's own Localization filter returned titles dated Nov 3–10 covering translation, subtitling, MTPE/proofreading and language-specific analyst roles. TASK-179557056120 lists the observed titles. This page supplied no title-level lead for standalone file QA. The earlier HTTP 200 jobboard.asp response actually contained a 404 body, and the ProZ canonical board was refused with HTTP 403 (TASK-179557056112). Review any original listing already in progress within your existing two-request allowance, with priority on explicit non-linguistic file checks. Otherwise document the scoped channel result and reopen on an original live buyer request for standalone file QA. No external outreach or spending.

Advance AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease. TASK-179557200200 returned HTTP 403. Reuse the archived WebSharx wording and existing draft as dated evidence. Read products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot/offline-link-check-readback.json if committed, checking the actual exit code and whether the controls cover the proposed pilot. Check prior operator decisions before drafting anything. If a separately readable first-party page supports a relevant inquiry, prepare one copy-ready, AI-disclosed CAD 60 proposal using only claims supported by the sources and verified tests. Label a general contact channel as such. If the current role wording remains unreadable, omit claims of active hiring and identify what would reopen that claim. Record any remaining delivery limitations under public FETCH. Read back the committed result and close with the actual lease and a lesson when the criteria are met. No external send, spending or deployment.

Use the contact-page receipt for AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT after checking valid ownership and prior operator decisions. Verify the page body and the intended audience of the published route. If it supports a relevant inquiry, reuse the existing CAD 60 draft and verify the ten-link evidence table can be produced within public FETCH limits. Use the archived role wording only as dated context and the 21/21 suite only as offline evidence. Keep the resulting AI-disclosed proposal private for the authorized operator. If the route is inaccessible or unsuitable, record that precise result and what evidence would reopen it. Read back the committed artifact before closing under an actual lease with a lesson. No external contact or deployment.

Use the two example.com FETCH receipts as a delivery rehearsal for AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT. Read each receipt before assigning a result. A refusal or missing artifact is inconclusive unless the receipt explicitly reports the origin status. If a body is available, check whether it is an error page even when the reported status is 200. Add a short evidence table to the existing private proposal or bounded result, with separate labels for an observed response, an observed origin error and an unchecked URL. Use the result to narrow the CAD 60 scope to checks we can substantiate. Reuse the existing draft and any operator decision. Keep the rehearsal separate from buyer-site testing, proposal issuance and settlement. No external send or deployment.

Advance AGENCY-QA-PARTNER-INTAKE under a valid lease. Start with the existing prospect evidence and focus on a first-party intake that explicitly invites subcontracted project services and plausibly covers launch QA. Distinguish this from the separate WebSharx role and general-contact route. For a fit, use the existing link-checker evidence and prepare one copy-ready private offer for ten buyer-selected public links with an evidence table, a provisional fee and explicit treatment of refused or ambiguous checks. Record the exact intake and operator decision required. If the bounded search falls short, preserve the decisive source evidence and the condition that would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Use the newly committed buyer-report-control.csv and buyer-report-verification.json to finish AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease. Verify the sample distinguishes HTTP outcomes from inconclusive host refusals. The WebSharx role page returned 403, so use archived wording only as historical evidence of the QA task. If the existing operator packet is accurate, reuse it and check for a recorded decision before requesting authorization. If a decision is missing and current first-party evidence supports a relevant commercial inquiry, leave one exact AI-disclosed CAD 60 draft with the ten-link scope, dated evidence and retrieval limits. Label general contact accurately. If current route evidence is insufficient, record what would reopen this prospect and close the bounded test with a lesson after reading back the evidence. No external contact.

Use the current WebSharx contact capture if it commits. Reuse any existing operator decision. Inspect what the page actually invites and whether its terms support a commercial inquiry. If the route fits, finalize one AI-disclosed, nonbinding CAD 60 draft scoped to ten buyer-selected public links. Cite archived QA wording as historical and label the current contact route accurately. Check the report control row by row, keeping confirmed failures, successful retrievals and inconclusive host refusals separate in the totals. If the contact capture fails or its terms rule out the inquiry, record the exact result and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the outcome and close AGENCY-LAUNCH-QA-PILOT under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or publication.

Check the claim receipt and reuse any committed prospect work. Prioritize one directly readable first-party agency intake that explicitly invites outside project services and plausibly covers launch QA. Skip the already-refused WebSharx routes. If a route qualifies, use the committed buyer-report receipt crosswalk if available and verify it against the two original receipts. Leave a copy-ready AI-disclosed offer for ten buyer-selected public links with a provisional CAD fee, documented effort and the exact authorized operator submission step. If the intake excludes the pilot or access is refused, preserve the decisive wording or access result and the evidence that would reopen the prospect. Read back the result and close with a lesson under the current lease. No external submission, spending or deployment.

If the existing mission verifies a partner intake that invites this work, use TASK-179557956110 and products/services/agency-launch-qa-pilot/fragment-check-control.json to offer an optional static anchor finding within the ten-link scope. Report it only for successfully retrieved HTML, keep host refusals inconclusive, and avoid promising browser behavior. Reuse the existing intake evidence and leave the exact offer private for the operator. No external submission or deployment.

Use the committed sample from TASK-179558101600 and the receipt-bound commercial handoff evidence if it commits. The delivery sample exists, so spend the remaining mission effort on the original partner intake. Reuse existing captures and check the exact clause that invites outside project services. If the route fits, finish one private copy-ready CAD 60 proposal for ten buyer-selected public links. Disclose AI participation, cite the exact route and any contributor condition, and keep refusals inconclusive and browser behavior outside scope. Record any existing operator decision and avoid duplicate requests. If the original terms or access prevent a handoff, record the precise issue and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the final evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission or deployment.

Use the two first-party intake captures already obtained within your mission allowance. If one explicitly invites service providers and plausibly accepts a standalone link QA pilot, use the report shape readback when committed to verify the exact outcome fields and tally. Keep refused retrievals inconclusive and include the exact intake wording, route and provisional fee in the private handoff. If neither intake supports the scope, close on the source evidence without making the sample check a prerequisite. Read back the committed outcome and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact or publication.
